challenge.better_approach: Looked at 6b0dfaa14efd itself: it is the ticket that made the change, but it carries no node_class, so rung 4 refuses it as kindless (reseal.py _ticket_refusal admits only a code-seam or a bug). Editing 6b0d's fixes is a rewrite of another box's ticket. A small bug ticket naming this one proof is the smallest admissible id.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the usage door belongs in _SOLE_PATH at all: 6b0d argues usage.py dials claude.ai, not the inference host. If the sieve's notion of the inference host is 'any urllib', the right fix would be narrowing the scan, not widening the list. The orchestrator accepted 6b0d's reading.

answers.traces_to: Law 9 (red is the default, green is earned) and Law 8 (prove, then trust): the proof stays red until the change to its claim carries a decision, and outline 19.14.8.2-3 says a fixit may change the test case itself when it names the ticket.
answers.what: inference_domain's test_host.py seals green over the _SOLE_PATH entries 0a699c443 added for the usage door, admitted at rung 4 by a bug ticket whose fixes lists the proof.

bullets.text: A proof edited under an open repair ladder stays unsealable until a ticket or answer admits it; 0a699c443 widened test_host's _SOLE_PATH without one, so every later seal of test_host was refused.
